lines.speaker: commentator
lines.text: Welcome to Harbor Park. Harbor City take on Northgate United.

lines.speaker: commentator
lines.text: And we're underway. Castillo starts it for Harbor City.

lines.speaker: commentator
lines.text: Harbor City knocking it around in midfield, Moreau looking for an opening.

lines.speaker: commentator
lines.text: Silva, the number seven, races down the right wing.

lines.speaker: commentator
lines.text: He shoots! Just wide of the far post.

lines.speaker: commentator
lines.text: Goal kick Northgate. Petrov plays it short.

lines.speaker: commentator
lines.text: Northgate building patiently through Tanaka and Bauer.

lines.speaker: commentator
lines.text: Okafor is through on goal.

lines.speaker: commentator
lines.text: What a save from Brandt! The Harbor City keeper stands tall.

lines.speaker: commentator
lines.text: Brandt rolls it out to Osei.

lines.speaker: commentator
lines.text: Harbor City pushing forward again.

lines.speaker: commentator
lines.text: Silva is brought down by Reyes.

lines.speaker: commentator
lines.text: Yellow card for Reyes, the number four.

lines.speaker: commentator
lines.text: Moreau whips in the free kick. Cleared by Lindqvist.

lines.speaker: commentator
lines.text: Northgate try to break, but Varga wins it back.

lines.speaker: commentator
lines.text: Varga in possession, Harbor City probing.

lines.speaker: commentator
lines.text: Lovely patient build-up from Harbor City.

lines.speaker: commentator
lines.text: Moreau finds Silva in space.

lines.speaker: commentator
lines.text: Silva shoots. Goal! Silva scores!

lines.speaker: commentator
lines.text: Harbor City lead one nil. The number seven wheels away to the corner flag.

lines.speaker: commentator
lines.text: Let's see that again. Moreau splits the defence, and Silva finishes low.

lines.speaker: commentator
lines.text: In slow motion, the keeper had no chance.

lines.speaker: commentator
lines.text: Northgate restart, one nil down.

lines.speaker: commentator
lines.text: Bauer and Costa trying to find a way back into this.

lines.speaker: commentator
lines.text: Corner to Northgate, Costa swings it in.

lines.speaker: commentator
lines.text: Lindqvist heads goalward, and Brandt saves again!

lines.speaker: commentator
lines.text: Brandt launches it long.

lines.speaker: commentator
lines.text: Harbor City looking to double the lead.

lines.speaker: commentator
lines.text: Bauer intercepts! Northgate break quickly, Okafor is clear.

lines.speaker: commentator
lines.text: Okafor shoots. Goal! One all!

lines.speaker: commentator
lines.text: Okafor celebrates in front of the travelling fans.

lines.speaker: commentator
lines.text: Here's the replay. Bauer reads the pass, and Okafor slots it past Brandt.

lines.speaker: commentator
lines.text: Clinical from the Northgate striker.

lines.speaker: commentator
lines.text: Harbor City kick off again, all square.

lines.speaker: commentator
lines.text: The home side pressing high now.

lines.speaker: commentator
lines.text: Silva cuts in from the wing, shoots, off the post!

lines.speaker: commentator
lines.text: Walsh hacks it clear. So close for Silva.

lines.speaker: commentator
lines.text: Northgate enjoying a spell of possession.

lines.speaker: commentator
lines.text: Novak slides in late on Costa. Yellow card for Novak, the number eight.

lines.speaker: commentator
lines.text: Northgate take the free kick quickly.

lines.speaker: commentator
lines.text: Harbor City win it back, Ferreira down the left.

lines.speaker: commentator
lines.text: Ferreira crosses. Silva heads it. Goal!

lines.speaker: commentator
lines.text: Two one to Harbor City!

lines.speaker: commentator
lines.text: Watch the replay. Ferreira's cross is perfect, and Silva powers the header in.

lines.speaker: commentator
lines.text: That's his second of the afternoon.

lines.speaker: commentator
lines.text: Northgate need a response.

lines.speaker: commentator
lines.text: Long balls forward from Northgate now.

lines.speaker: commentator
lines.text: Okafor, one last chance. Saved by Brandt!

lines.speaker: commentator
lines.text: Harbor City see out the final moments.

lines.speaker: commentator
lines.text: And there's the final whistle! Harbor City two, Northgate United one.
